Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance.effect: Hooking a survivor on a Scourge Hook instantly damages the farthest generator and blocks it for a short time.

Corrupt Intervention.effect: Blocks the 3 generators farthest from you for the first couple minutes of the match.

Surge.effect: Downing a survivor damages all generators within 32 meters.

THWACK!.effect: Breaking a pallet or wall causes survivors within range to scream and reveals their location.

Hex: Ruin.effect: While active, generators regress automatically when not being repaired — until the totem is cleansed.

Barbecue & Chilli.effect: After hooking a survivor, see the auras of survivors far from the hook for several seconds.

Barbecue & Chili.effect: After hooking a survivor, see the auras of survivors far from the hook for several seconds.

Lethal Pursuer.effect: See every survivor's aura for several extra seconds at the start of the trial.

Friends 'Til the End.effect: Unhooking a survivor grants both of you a haste and endurance effect for a short time.

Dead Man's Switch.effect: Hooking a survivor blocks the generator being worked on farthest from you.

Brutal Strength.effect: Increases the speed of breaking pallets and breakable walls.

Nowhere to Hide.effect: Kicking a generator reveals the aura of survivors within range.

Pop Goes the Weasel.effect: After hooking a survivor, the next generator you kick loses a large chunk of progress instantly.

Bamboozle.effect: Increases vault speed and can permanently block a window after vaulting it.

Thanatophobia.effect: Every injured, dying, or hooked survivor slows the whole team's repair/heal/sabotage/cleansing speed.

Enduring.effect: Reduces the stun duration when a survivor hits you with a pallet.

Darkness Revealed.effect: After damaging a generator, see the aura of the nearest survivor for several seconds.

Sloppy Butcher.effect: Injured survivors bleed more and heal slower.

Eruption.effect: Kicking a generator sets a trap — the next survivor who fails a skill check on it triggers a big regression.

Hex: Devour Hope.effect: Each unhook away from your notice adds a token; at 5 tokens, downing a survivor is an instant kill — until the totem is cleansed.

Windows of Opportunity.effect: Permanently reveals the auras of nearby pallets and breakable walls.

Lithe.effect: Performing a fast vault grants a burst of speed (Haste).

Deja Vu.effect: Reveals the auras of the 3 generators most central to the map, and slightly speeds up repairing them.

Resilience.effect: While injured, gain a bonus to action speeds (repairing, healing, vaulting, etc.).

Dead Hard.effect: While exhausted-eligible, dash forward briefly to dodge the killer's hit.

Finesse.effect: Reduces the killer's ability to hear your grunts of pain and see blood, and improves stealth vaults.

Sprint Burst.effect: While running at full stamina, the first time you sprint you get a burst of speed.

Decisive Strike.effect: For a short time after being unhooked, being grabbed or picked up lets you stun the killer and escape their grasp.

Adrenaline.effect: When the exit gates power, instantly heal one health state and gain a burst of Haste.

Bond.effect: See the auras of other survivors within range at all times.

Prove Thyself.effect: Increases repair speed for every survivor working the same generator together.

Jolt.effect: Downing a survivor regresses all generators within 32 meters.
